nom: Clinique Acne Solutions Acne + Line Correcting Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the serum absorbs without leaving an oily layer and helps with shine and enlarged pores, though outcomes on acne itself vary.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin found it hydrating and normalizing rather than drying, though another with sensitive dry skin was hesitant before trying it.
segments.combination: A reviewer with large pores and combination skin reports softer skin and reduced acne redness and size within days.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or sensitive-acne-prone skin mostly report no irritation and gentle results, though one with extremely sensitive and acne-prone skin says it flared her acne after a week.
segments.normal: One reviewer identifying as normal skin (not oily or dry) reports it cleared chin acne within a month without drying her skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s-40s combining acne with early signs of aging report the serum addresses both, though several also say the fine-line effect is unproven or not yet visible.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers past 30-40 report no visible reduction in fine lines even after weeks of use, calling the anti-aging claim unproven; a few others say they are hopeful or see early smoothing but have not yet judged wrinkle results.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the serum does not dry out their skin and even improves hydration and plumpness; one dry-skin reviewer confirms comfortable, non-drying wear.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin, but one describes new red bumps appearing after about a month of use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports a burn-like reaction and welts, and another reports the product killed a long-standing mole, suggesting a strong or irritating reaction in some skin.
concerns.spots: Reviewers mention residual acne marks and dark spots persisting after acne itself improves; one specifically asks for advice on fading red marks, indicating spots are not resolved by this product alone.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with adult, hormonal, or cystic acne report noticeable clearing or reduced frequency of breakouts within one to four weeks; however, a substantial minority report the product caused new or worsened breakouts, sometimes attributed to purging.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily or combination skin report the serum controls shine and does not add an oily film, describing it as mattifying.

aspects.libelle: Small bottle size for the price

extraits.texte: I am a 42-year-old who just recently started battling acne for the first time ever; on top of that, my skin is aging, so I feel like I am battling two things at once. My friends call me "crunchy" since I prefer to use organic brands like Juice Beauty or Andalou Naturals, but my usual go-to acne products were not helping my most recent flare-up of pimples. I decided to ignore ingredients for once and try something new and I was pleasantly surprised to find a product that tackles both fine lines and acne at the same time. I bought it without batting an eye, despite the hefty price tag. The first night I used it, it did seem to help with acne and my skin felt like oily than it had; however, I did notice my skin seemed red and agitated. It was not anything awful like breaking out in a rash or hives, just not happy skin. After my third or fourth night of use, I noticed that it was having an effect on a mole I have had for at least 10 years. Y'all, I'm not even lying, but this product destroyed my mole. Now, I was not emotionally attached to this mole, but my mole never hurt anyone and it was fine just sitting there on my face. This product killed it -- it was like it ate it off of my skin. Yes, I know that sounds disgusting, but that's literally what happened. After the 4th time and me noticing my mole dying, I stopped using the product altogether. It was too late to save my mole. (RIP mole) While I want something to kill my acne, I think it's a little too strong if it can do that

extraits.titre: My holy grail products to treat my acne
extraits.texte: Quick back story on my skin: when I was like a teenager, I had pretty good skin, a pimple here and there, nothing too bad. But as I got into college to now (I'm 24) I've been more stressed, bad lifestyle choices, etc, my acne has been sooo bad, mostly around my chin/cheek area. So rn, my skin is combo/oily, and the warmer months always break me out, along with the time of the month and stuff. Ok now this product is amazing. I use this twice a day. So I cleanse my face first, use a toner, then I use this, small drop each on my chin, cheeks, forehead, and nose, then I finish with a mattifying moisturizer. And within a few days, I start to see the inflammation and redness of my acne start to go down as long as if I don't touch my face or try to pop things (which I have a bad habit of doing lol) but whenever I run out of this, my skin goes crazy, so it's def a staple in my routine, and I've been using this for about 4 months, and I just bought my second bottle. Hope my story helps you guys!

I have big, painful chin zits that get worse during my time of the month. This stuff has cleared my acne within a month! I have tried so many other things but clinique's acne solutions doesn't dry out my skin. My skin now looks radiant. I have normal skin type (not oily or dry). After washing my face twice a day I use #2 clarifying lotion, acne + line correcting serum on my chin and forehead, the clinical clearing gel on zits, then finish with the dramatically different moisturizing gel. Its expensive but worth it!

I love Clinique but they took it to a whole other level with this product. Most importantly— it's gentle for sensitive skin. I'm in my early 30s and became extremely dry and sensitive with breakouts. My skin hates me in my 30s. I tried literally everything and this was one of the only things that helped normalize my red flaky acne prone skin. It didn't take long to work either. I literally got a sample of it and it has already really improved.

extraits.titre: treat your skin! worth the money!
extraits.texte: this is a pricey skin item but it is awesome because I have large pores and combination skin this is amazing after a few days my skin already looks and feels softer and my acne is going down in redness and size! this is a definite holy Grail as well as repurchasing item!
I have been using this for about 3 months now, and I'm a big fan. I use a dime size amount after toning before any primer, spf, or foundation. Its a godsend for my oily but aging skin.
